places.ad: 20 Ghim Moh Road, Singapore 270020
places.w: The Holland-Ghim Moh district's great hawker centre: opened in 1978, rebuilt in a 2015 facelift and refreshed again in a March-May 2024 renovation, yet still old-school neighbourhood in feel — around 72 cooked-food stalls over a wet market, famous for chwee kueh, braised duck, hor fun and carrot cake, a short walk from Buona Vista MRT.
places.k: Hawker centre & wet market; most stalls breakfast-to-lunch, some till evening

places.ad: 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: The Holland Drive estate's two-storey market and food centre, home to a Michelin Bib Gourmand claypot rice (New Lucky), a Michelin-recognised kway chap (Cheng Heng), Margaret Drive Sin Kee chicken rice and a well-loved Malay breakfast stall — the residents' hawker centre just south of the Holland V bar strip.
places.k: Hawker centre & wet market; cooked food upstairs

places.ad: Lorong Mambong, Holland Village
places.w: A long-time bohemian expat enclave of eateries, bars and shophouses off Holland Road.

places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, #01-04, 20 Ghim Moh Road, S270020
places.w: Ghim Moh's Michelin Bib Gourmand duck stall: boneless Teochew-style braised duck over rice, kway teow or congee, dressed in a dark herbal gravy whose braising stock is reused and replenished daily — a $3-$5 bowl with years of depth in it.

places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, #01-54, 20 Ghim Moh Road, S270020
places.w: A household name since 1959 and a Michelin Guide pick: soft-but-springy steamed rice cakes (minimum four) heaped with chye poh fried over a charcoal stove, which gives the preserved radish a smokier depth than the gas-cooked norm.

places.n: Guan Kee Fried Kway Teow — CLOSED
places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, 20 Ghim Moh Road, S270020
places.w: Started in 1969 and at Ghim Moh since 1978, this was one of Singapore's most-queued char kway teow stalls (Bib Gourmand 2019) — it closed for good on 28 Nov 2023 when its 77-year-old owner retired after fainting at the wok. Kept here as a flagged closure.

pv.ss: Closed 28 Nov 2023 on owners' retirement — Eatbook + Seth Lui (Nov 2023) + Wikipedia, reconfirmed via WebSearch 2026-10-02

places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, #01-16, 20 Ghim Moh Road, S270020
places.w: The most popular carrot cake at Ghim Moh — a family stall that makes both the radish cake and the chye poh from scratch daily; the queue starts at 6:30am and limited portions sell out, rewarding early birds with strong wok hei.

places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, #01-44, 20 Ghim Moh Road, S270020
places.w: Fried to order over a superheated wok so the flat rice noodles take on real wok hei before the gravy goes in — the brown-sauce beef hor fun is the bestseller; written up by Dr Leslie Tay and Miss Tam Chiak and tested by Seth Lui as one of Singapore's best-rated hor fun.

places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, #01-26, 20 Ghim Moh Road, S270020
places.w: Formerly Heavens Indian Curry, now a mother-and-son appam and thosai specialist: lacy-edged, pillow-centred fermented-rice appam with grated coconut and orange sugar, or the indulgent 'Princess' crowned with butter, cheddar and a fried egg.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-19, 44 Holland Drive, S270044
places.w: Holland Drive's headline stall and a Michelin Bib Gourmand year after year (incl. 2024 and 2025): every claypot is cooked from scratch over charcoal, so the grains stay separate with a crackling crust — call ahead, because the wait can run to an hour.

places.n: Cheng Heng Kway Chap and Braised Duck Rice
places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-05, 44 Holland Drive, S270044
places.w: A Michelin-recognised kway chap (Michelin Plate, 2018) where the broad rice sheets swim in a herbal soy broth beside braised pork and innards, plus the stall's famous finely sliced braised duck — expect a 30-minute morning queue.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-12, 44 Holland Drive, S270044
places.w: The Malay stall at Holland Drive that tastes like someone's mum cooked it — creamy coconut lontong and mee soto in the morning, then a changing nasi padang spread (rendang, petai, curry chicken) that sells out early.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-15, 44 Holland Drive, S270044
places.w: One of Holland Drive's busier stalls: springy Hakka noodles heaped with yong tau foo pieces and crisp fried wantons — a generous neighbourhood bowl.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-28/29, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: A MICHELIN Bib Gourmand hawker across two adjoining stalls: noodle soup or 'dry' noodles with minced pork, pork balls or fish balls hand-made on the spot — the yellowtail fishballs are the draw.

places.n: Yuan Hokkien Fried Prawn Mee (Ghim Moh)
places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, 20 Ghim Moh Road, Singapore 270020 (unit to confirm)
places.w: A Margaret Drive Food Centre transplant: white and yellow noodles wok-fried down in a rich stock of prawn heads, squid and pork bones — one of the Ghim Moh picks shared by Women's Weekly and Her World.

places.n: Yuan Authentic Thai Stewed Beef Noodle (Ghim Moh)
places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, 20 Ghim Moh Road, Singapore 270020 (unit to confirm)
places.w: Run by a cook from Chiang Rai: Thai stewed and sliced beef noodle soup — beefy, aromatic broth, beef balls, slices and tendon, small bowls from under $3 — a Thai hawker kitchen in an otherwise Chinese-heavy centre (Eatbook review; Women's Weekly and Her World Ghim Moh lists).

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-02, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: The kway chap stall Miss Tam Chiak calls chef Daniel Tay's favourite: silky rice sheets in a herbal braising broth with a spread of braised pork, offal and egg — written up by Daniel Food Diary, SG Food on Foot and in Eatbook's 13 best Holland Drive stalls.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044 (unit to confirm)
places.w: Holland Drive's Malay stall for ayam penyet: fragrant rice, fried chicken, tempeh, tau kwa, cucumber and sambal from about $4.50-$5 — on both Eatbook's and Women's Weekly's Holland Drive lists.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-36, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: The $3 char siew and roast pork rice that Eatbook headlines in its Holland Drive guide; Women's Weekly also lists it among the centre's 10 best.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044 (unit to confirm)
places.w: Black or white chai tow kway in $3/$4/$5 portions — the carrot cake pick of both Eatbook and Women's Weekly at Holland Drive.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-35, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: Young hawkers baking affordable shio pan from scratch inside a hawker centre — a newer Holland Drive draw named by Seth Lui's 11 best and covered by Eatbook.

places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, 20 Ghim Moh Road, Singapore 270020 (unit to confirm)
places.w: A short-hours roast-meat counter (10am-2pm, Thursday to Sunday) for roast duck, crackling roast pork and char siew — reviewed by Miss Tam Chiak and listed by Women's Weekly / Her World among Ghim Moh's best.

places.n: Lao Chen Ji Sarawak Kolo Mee (Holland Drive)
places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-43, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: Springy Sarawak kolo mee, served with yong tau foo pieces — a regulars' favourite named by HungryGoWhere, Daniel Food Diary (2023), Johor Kaki and Women's Weekly.

places.n: Fifty Year Yong Tau Foo (Holland Drive)
places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-37, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: Freshly made Hakka yong tau foo over flat mee kia noodles — a fifty-year name that HungryGoWhere, Johor Kaki and Eatbook all list among Holland Drive's regulars' picks.

places.n: Yap Kee Wanton Egg Noodles (Holland Drive)
places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044 (unit to confirm)
places.w: Wanton mee made with egg noodles supplied by the owner's brother in Johor Bahru (Johor Kaki) — on HungryGoWhere's and Eatbook's Holland Drive lists.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-13, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: Restaurant-quality Turkish food at hawker prices — tombik, döner, pide and falafel — picked by Seth Lui and HungryGoWhere.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044 (unit to confirm)
places.w: Holland Drive's vegetarian stall, a regulars' pick on HungryGoWhere and in Daniel Food Diary's 2023 Holland Drive round-up.

places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-09, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: A handmade-bao stall named in Daniel Food Diary's 2023 Holland Drive guide and Eatbook's 13 best Holland Drive stalls.

places.n: Lin Da Ma Lei Cha (Holland Drive)
places.ad: Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, #02-21, 44 Holland Drive, Singapore 270044
places.w: Hakka thunder tea rice with a modern twist: brown rice, chopped vegetables, peanuts and ikan bilis under a thick basil-based tea soup (Daniel Food Diary); also in Seth Lui's 11 best Holland Drive stalls.

places.n: Thiam Kee 1977 Hainanese Chicken Rice (Ghim Moh)
places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, #01-19, 20 Ghim Moh Road, Singapore 270020
places.w: Thick, succulent slices of steamed chicken over fragrant rice — a $5.50 set with soup and greens or bean sprouts — at Ghim Moh, picked in Seth Lui's 11 best Ghim Moh stalls and found in Daniel Food Diary's best chicken rice round-up.

places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, 20 Ghim Moh Road, Singapore 270020 (stall to confirm)
places.w: A durian stall trading Malaysian fruit for over 40 years — Mao Shan Wang, Black Thorn, Golden Phoenix, Red Prawn — that Time Out singles out for 'reliability and excellent durians' and Eatbook ranks among Singapore's 15 best durian stalls.

places.ad: Ghim Moh Market & Food Centre, #01-30, 20 Ghim Moh Road, Singapore 270020
places.w: After pivoting to chee cheong fun only, this Ghim Moh stall draws queues from 6.30am — in Eatbook's 10 Ghim Moh stalls and Miss Tam Chiak's chee cheong fun round-up.

places.n: Margaret Drive Sin Kee Chicken Rice
places.ad: #02-06 Holland Drive Market & Food Centre, 44 Holland Drive
places.w: Steamed chicken rice since 1978; on the Michelin Bib Gourmand list since 2018.
